title: TradeCode
tagline: 🌐 Introducing TradeCode: Our Web3 DApp fights counterfeiting & streamlines trademark registration using blockchain & NFTs. Secure, transparent, and efficient authentication for products & services. 🛡️🔗 #TradeCode #Blockchain #DApp #NFTs
description: We propose building a Web3 decentralized application (DApp) based on the Lean Canvas model to address the problem of counterfeiting and inefficient trademark registration practices. The DApp will leverage blockchain technology and NFTs (Non-Fungible Tokens) to provide a secure, transparent, and efficient solution for verifying the authenticity and ownership of products, goods, and services. The DApp, called TradeCode, will offer unique identification, traceability, and a tamper-proof chain of custody information.
how_its_made: TradeCode, our Web3 DApp, combats counterfeiting and improves trademark registration. We used Ethereum, NFTs, and Lean Canvas. Smart contracts handle processes, prioritizing security, scalability, and community engagement with a focus on user education. Notable challenges include gas optimization and data management. In a nutshell, TradeCode leverages advanced tech for a secure, efficient solution in the fight against counterfeiting.
